lines.t: Thrown into a world, given no foundation
Navigating life before you found your footing
Truth was never shown to you
No straight path to guide your way
Left to figure it out
While your heart was led astray
Every step tearing at you more
Leaving a weight you’d carry all your days
Ohhh, carrying your broken heart
Wondering why, even after all these years
It will not heal
Oh, oh, oh, brokenhearted
The wounds of disappointment
Left their scars so deep
You know rejoicing comes in the morning
Yet it feels you’ll spend this lifetime
Clutching a forever broken heart
You’ve known the joy of knowing Him
A love you never could explain
Yet in the quiet of the night
You feel those wounds again
Battling the flesh
With the pressure closing in
Trying to keep your footsteps straight
While your heart aches deep within
Ohhh, carrying your broken heart
Wondering why, even after all these years
It will not heal
Oh, oh, oh, brokenhearted
The wounds of disappointment
Left their scars so deep
You know rejoicing comes in the morning
Yet it feels you’ll spend this lifetime
Clutching a forever broken heart
Life left you disappointed
From a very young age
But you never thought you’d bear its scars
Throughout all your days
Behind closed doors, your tears fall
And you cannot trace them back
Is it the weight of all you carry
Or the strength it takes to face each day
You thought you were alone.
You thought no one could see.
You thought you had to bear it on your own…
Until you were reminded:
“Weeping may endure for a night,
But joy comes in the morning.”
Ohhh, He knows your broken heart
Every ache you couldn’t put in words
He’s seen you all these years
Oh, oh, oh, brokenhearted
Every tear you cry in secret
Is held within His hands
Hold on, this night won’t last forever
Though your heart is aching still
There is healing in His promise
And a morning yet to come
Rejoicing shall come in the morning
